title: Lost item at hotel (stronger)
question:
You recently stayed at a hotel and left something valuable in your room.

Write a letter to the hotel manager. In your letter
• give details of your stay
• describe the item you left behind
• say what you would like the manager to do

Write at least 150 words. You do NOT need to write any addresses.

Begin your letter as follows:
Dear Sir or Madam,
essay:
Dear Sir or Madam,

I am writing regarding an item I believe I left behind during my recent stay at your hotel, and I would be very grateful for your assistance in locating it.

My partner and I stayed in Room 418 from Friday 12th to Sunday 14th April for a family wedding. We thoroughly enjoyed our visit; the staff were attentive and the room was spotless, which is why I am confident the item will have been handed in if it was found.

The item in question is a small gold bracelet with a heart-shaped charm engraved with the initials "M.K." Although it is not especially valuable in monetary terms, it belonged to my late grandmother, so it is irreplaceable to me. I recall taking it off on the Sunday morning and placing it on the bedside table, so it may have been gathered up with the bedding.

I would be grateful if you could check with your housekeeping team and your lost property office. Should it be found, I would appreciate it if you could send it to me by registered post; I will, of course, cover the cost in advance. Please feel free to contact me by email or on 07700 900123.

Thank you in advance for your help.

Yours faithfully,
Maya Kumar
